RIDER: We reviewed your fare dispute and are refunding $2.56 to your original payment method. Your trip followed the route we quoted. The extra charge came from the price multiplier going up from 1.2x to 1.5x after your ride started; you should have been told before the ride began, and the notice only reached you once you were already in the car. The $2.56 is the difference between your upfront quote and the final fare. It should appear on your original payment method shortly. No action is needed from you, and your account is not flagged.

DRIVER: We reviewed a fare dispute on your trip and are refunding $2.56 to the rider's original payment method. The route you drove matched the quoted route, so the route itself was not the issue. The difference came from the multiplier rising from 1.2x to 1.5x after the trip started, and the rider should have been notified before pickup but was not. This will appear as an adjustment; no action is needed from you. We are not recording any violation or sending a reminder, because you drove the route the app gave you and the price is set by the app.
